provenance.judge_method: Re-viewed the 25 Commons/Mapillary files + 4 rights-reserved Tulane references. Ties broken by: (a) roofline tracing at 6-7x on Newcomb_Blvd_2019_18, Zimple_2018 and April_2019_05 to decide whether recessed bays and flat panel share a face; (b) camera-position reasoning from the OSM footprint corners, neighbouring buildings (Dixon Hall NNE, St Martin de Porres chapel NW, Freret/Zimple/Audubon houses W-NW) and solar azimuth (29 Mar 2019 10:41 CDT = az 121 deg, el 47 deg); (c) full-face window counts (Zimple WNW row ~33 lights; 2007 SSW 3 lights per storefront bay of 5 mullion lights; drawing/Feb-2026 ESE 6 per bay); (d) fresh median-colour samples on the disputed regions. Judge crops in scratchpad/judge/.

wall.material: precast concrete with exposed light aggregate (fine pebbly, lightly sandblasted; buff-white matrix with grey-cream speckle), organised as ~1.2 m structural piers at the 7.9 m bay lines, projecting vertical fins and flat recessed panels; storeys 1-4, all four faces
measured_from: pass2: 2019 even light #ada9a0 calibrated vs white truck -> #c2beb6
judge: 2019 portrait pier #a09b93 (even light), 2018 overcast pier #aeada6, 2007 sunlit pier #9a938d (mixed)
wall.vs_model_constant: build_model WALL #d6cec2 is lighter and yellower; real precast is a greyer off-white (b* ~4.5) and reads darker because of dense vertical fin shadows

structural_bays.note: 11 on the long sides from the elevation drawing, ortho teeth and Feb-2026 fin fit; 6 on the short sides from 2007 ground-floor pier count (5 storefront lights per bay ~7.5-7.9 m)

trim.material: dark red-brown (oxblood) painted metal/precast bands: ~0.35 m strip under the terrace (storey-4) slab recessed behind the fins, and a continuous strip over the ground-floor storefront (soffit edge); on the SSW (Freret) face only, a red-brown panel fills the bottom ~20-25% of every slit light (2007 and Nov 2021)
measured_from: judge 2007 sill panel #32302d (shade), 2019 band #7e7763 (mixed with slab)

sill_panels.note: present on Freret face in 2007 and 2021; absent on NNE (2019) and WNW (2013, 2018); ESE not seen (2026 twilight/photos show plain dark glass)

glazing.notes: upper windows: neutral dark-grey glass in dark-bronze anodised frames with a transom ~1/3 from the top (reads sky-blue in sun, near-black in shade)

ground_floor.description: continuous full-height bronze-tinted storefront between piers, ~5 lights (~1.5 m) per bay, recessed ~1.5 m under a dark soffit, beige curtains inside; entrance doors on ESE near the Freret corner

terrace_floor.description: storey 4 continuous glazing behind the balustrade; dark void under the overhang

ESE_87m.layout: 6 evenly spaced tall windows per bay, a projecting fin between each; transom ~1/3 down

SSW_NNE_WNW.layout: one narrow light per 2.6 m unit, each light with ONE projecting fin beside it (light + fin + ~1.3 m flat panel); the fin's shadow is easily misread as a second light; a few positions on WNW/NNE hold pale louvred vents

pattern.stacked: storey-2 and storey-3 lights align vertically with a ~0.3 m spandrel at the floor line
pattern.note: pass 1's 2.6 m rhythm is right for the slit faces (but its 0.85 m window is too wide: ~0.6 m light + 0.7 m fin); pass 2's 6-per-bay is right for ESE only

base.material: exposed-aggregate precast plinth/podium ~1.0 m (coarser pebble than the walls) with a projecting slab edge; continuous precast planter boxes on the podium in front of the storefront; entrance steps + ramp with metal rails on ESE near the Freret corner; iron picket fence along Freret and Newcomb Place

entrance.side: ESE (Newcomb Place) near the S/Freret corner
entrance.features: glass doors in the storefront line under the fin-floor overhang, building name lettering on the pier, ramp + steps, drop-off loop

roof_edge.description: original flat roof slab projects ~1.5-2 m beyond the storey-4 glazing with a ~0.7 m pale precast fascia, exposed beam ends and a dark soffit; balustrade (~1.0 m, rail on squat posts) ~1 m inside the slab edge; now a continuous cornice band under the addition
roof_edge.addition_roof_edge: flush thin light-metal coping (~0.4 m), no parapet upstand; roof = white membrane with PV arrays + 3 mechanical enclosures (height:max 32.6 m)

upper_addition.material: flat light silver-grey aluminium composite panels (vertical joints ~1.0-1.2 m, horizontal joints ~1.5 m), satin finish reflecting the sky: near-white in direct sun, pale blue-grey overcast, deep sky-blue at low sun angles. Loggia bays (ESE and the W corner): deep (~2.5 m) white/light-grey aluminium fin frames with fastener rows, dark-charcoal ribbed/perforated metal jambs and soffits, dark-tinted curtain-wall glazing on the back wall (both storeys). Slots: narrow full-height recessed glazing strips in the flat panels.

ESE_87m.layout: 11-bay loggia over the full length; fins reach the original slab edge

SSW_46m.layout: from the W corner: 3-4 deep loggia-type recessed bays (~22-25 m), short flat panel, a tight group of 3-4 full-height slots, then flat panel to the S corner
SSW_46m.evidence: Newcomb_Blvd_2019_18 (continuous roofline across bays+panel, 6+ ESE bays to the right), April_2019_05, c3d_HTML_pic_3

WNW_87m.layout: from the N corner: flat panel with 3 spread slots over ~2/3 of the length, then 3 deep recessed loggia-type bays at the S (Freret) end
WNW_87m.evidence: Zimple_Street_2018 (N end nearer; bays at the far/S end), 2023 distant view, 2013/2014 context

NNE_46m.layout: flat panel with 3 slots; flat N corner, no recessed bays; possibly one recess adjacent to the loggia at the E corner (unverified)
NNE_46m.evidence: 2019 portrait (relabelled NNE), Zimple_2018 grazing left face

faces.corner_W: the SSW and WNW recessed bays meet at the W (Freret/Audubon) corner as a two-sided corner loggia (~3+3-4 bays)

upper_addition.setback: panel wall ~1.2 m inside the original slab edge on WNW/SSW/NNE (light strip in the ortho); loggia fins reach the slab edge on ESE (and at the W-corner bays, causing a small roofline jog in Zimple_2018)
measured_from: judge: 2018 overcast #b2bcc5, Apr-2019 sun #c1d3ea, Nov-2019 low-sun sky reflection #6fa4e7, Feb-2026 end panel sky-lit #9aadcd

cross_checks_lidar.assessment: 4 original storeys (4.8+4.0+4.0+4.2 + 0.7 slab = 17.7 m) + 2-storey addition (10.7 m) = 28.4 m, matching the LiDAR eave; height:max 32.6 m = rooftop mechanical enclosures (seen in 2002 rooftop photo and 2025 ortho).
cross_checks_lidar.footprint: 87.0 x 46.0 m rectangle, long axis 31.6 deg; single flat roof plane agrees; ortho roof colour will be dominated by dark-blue PV arrays.
cross_checks_lidar.ortho_caveat: the addition loggia has a continuous top fascia, so the roof outline is straight everywhere; the 11 ESE teeth are relief displacement of the ESE wall face only and the ortho cannot confirm or exclude recessed bays on the other faces.
cross_checks_lidar.model_material_gap: build_model.py uses one beige WALL=[214,206,194] (#d6cec2). Real lower 17.7 m = greyer precast (#c2beb6 sunlit / #a8a49c diffuse) dominated by fin shadows; top 10.7 m = light silver-grey metal (#c4cad1, specular) with an 11-bay black/white loggia on ESE and a two-sided corner loggia at the W corner.

render_recommendations: split the wall material at z=17.7 m; add a projecting pale cornice slab (0.7 m fascia, ~2 m overhang) at that line

lower block: precast #c2beb6 with fin relief or a fin-shadow texture: ESE = 6 windows per 7.9 m bay (0.75 m glass, 0.5 m fins); other faces = 3 slit lights per bay (0.6 m glass + 0.7 m fin per 2.6 m); stacked pairs storeys 2-3 with transoms; storey 4 = dark glass void behind a 1 m balustrade
ground floor: 1 m plinth, dark bronze storefront #4f463a recessed 1.5 m behind 1.2 m piers, red-brown strip at the soffit edge, planters
red-brown band under the storey-4 slab all round; red-brown sill panels on the Freret (SSW) slits only

addition: panel #c4cad1 with specular sky term, set back 1.2 m from the slab edge on WNW/SSW/NNE; ESE = 11 loggia bays (#e6e8ea fins, #24272c recess, #2f3e39 glass); SSW = 3-4 loggia bays at the W end + 3-4 slot group; WNW = 3 slots + 3 loggia bays at the S end; NNE = 3 slots
roof: white membrane with PV blocks + 3 enclosures to 32.6 m
notes: Face-label corrections: Zimple_Street_2018 is the WNW face (pass 2 right, pass 1 wrong); the 29-Mar-2019 portrait is the NNE face seen from its E end (pass 1 right about the face, wrong about the viewpoint; pass 2 wrong) - decided by bay/light count (~18-21 lights, not 33), the flat far corner (WNW's S end has recessed bays), the brick wall on the Dixon Hall side and the grey-green metal-roofed chapel beyond the far corner.

Pass 1's 'other three edges are plain, settled by the ortho' is rejected: the ortho cannot see recesses under a continuous fascia; three ground photos show the Freret W-end bays and one shows the WNW S-end bays.

Pass 2's '6 lights per bay (3 pairs) on the slit faces' is rejected: the 2007 3.4x zoom shows one light + one fin per 2.6 m unit and the Zimple WNW row counts ~33, not 66; pass 2 is right that ESE has 6 per bay.
Pass 1 colour_measurements labelled 'roof-slab fascia (original), sunlit' (#766254) is the shaded band/soffit, not the pale fascia (judge remeasured the same zone: #7d695b).
Transient conditions in the set: 2013 silver ducts, Nov 2021 scaffold canopy and tan boarding, 2019 Commons construction fence, 2014 weather barrier.
Rights-reserved Tulane campus-map images were used only to read layout; do not bake them into textures.
